label: sdc01_0230_gfather_01
text: This is going to be a bit of a long story to tell...\nIs that all right?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_gfather_02
text: Well, do let me know when it is all right, then.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_gfather_03
text: This story has been passed down in our family by\nword of mouth. I learned it from my father.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_gfather_04
text: It’s a story of truths... A story that must never\nbe told to the rest of the village.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_gfather_05
text: You must never speak of it to others.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_01
text: A long, long time ago, a man and an ogre came\nto Kitakami from a foreign land.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_02
text: The people of the village feared the man and the\nogre, who looked so different from them...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_03
text: And so they refused to let the travelers come\nanywhere near the village.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_04
text: The man and the ogre were saddened that the\nvillagers did not welcome them...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_05
text: But they were happy just to have each other.\nThey settled quietly in a cave on the mountain.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_06
text: There was only one villager who pitied the two\ntravelers: the village mask maker.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_07
text: He made several masks for the man and the ogre.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_08
text: The masks were brilliant works, adorned with\ngems the man brought from somewhere far away.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_09
text: By wearing these masks, the travelers could hide\ntheir true faces and mingle with the villagers.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_10
text: The man and the ogre were overjoyed.\nThey thanked the mask maker for his kindness.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_11
text: Wearing the masks, the man and the ogre started\nsecretly joining the village festival.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_12
text: The mysterious pair soon became the talk of the\nvillage because of their brilliant masks.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_13
text: In fact, rumors about them quickly spread far and\nwide, even to distant lands.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_14
text: But rumors of exquisite, shining masks attract\nmore than just innocent curiosity...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_15
text: A group of greedy Pokémon soon made their way\nto the land of Kitakami.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_16
text: These Pokémon sneaked into the cave in which\nthe man and the ogre lived...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_17
text: and tried to make off with the masks, which were\ncarefully stored away.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_18
text: The man happened to be there. He managed to\nhold on to one of the masks...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_19
text: but he was not strong enough to protect them all.\nThe Pokémon stole the other three masks.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_20
text: Several hours later, when the ogre returned to\nthe cave...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_21
text: it found its beloved home in ruin. All that was left\nwere the signs of a struggle and a teal mask.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_22
text: The ogre donned that mask and went down to\nthe village, perhaps to search for its friend.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_23
text: It found the greedy Pokémon there, gloating over\ntheir stolen masks, and defeated them.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_24
text: The villagers, of course, had no idea what was\nhappening nor why.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_25
text: All they saw was the raging ogre. And they felt\ngreat fear.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_26
text: The villagers thought the three Pokémon had\nfallen trying to protect the village from the ogre.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_27
text: To honor their sacrifice, the villagers named them\nthe Loyal Three and interred them with care.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0230_history_28
text: Wounded and weak, the ogre returned to its\ncave—alone and with great sadness.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
